newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Seven dead in Guatemala land dispute.
newsitem.headline: Seven dead in Guatemala land dispute.

text.p: At least seven people have been killed and 35 to 40 injured in fighting over an old land dispute in western Guatemala, emergency workers said on Monday.
"There could be more than seven dead," Abelardo Diaz of the volunteer rescue squad in nearby Quetzaltenango told Reuters.

From Sunday night to Monday morning, rescue officials took between 35 and 40 injured villagers to nearby hospitals with bullet wounds, burns from homemade bombs or blows with machetes and sticks, he said.

The battle was sparked by a long-running dispute over a parcel of land near this village that is claimed by residents of two separate provinces. The village is about 100 miles (160 km) from Guatemala City, the capital.
Troops and riot police were being sent to restore order.
